CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.can_manage_schedules(p_user text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select coalesce(p_user in ('2026M0004','2026M0003') and exists(select 1 from mschool.users u join mschool.staff_access a on a.user_id=u.id where u.id=p_user and a.is_active and u.role_type='同工' and coalesce(u.status,'在班') in ('在班','在職')),false); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.payroll_due_month(p_local timestamp without time zone)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select case when x>='2026-11-01'::date then x end from(select case when p_local::date=(date_trunc('month',p_local)+interval '1 month -1 day')::date and p_local::time>=time '21:00' then date_trunc('month',p_local)::date else (date_trunc('month',p_local)-interval '1 month')::date end x)t;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.payroll_stage_actor(p_stage text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select case p_stage when 'yuting' then '2026M0004' when 'enru' then '2026M0003' when 'wife' then '2026M0002' when 'pastor' then '2026M0001' end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mschool.person_can_checkin(p_role text, p_status text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select case when coalesce(p_role,'學生')='學生' then coalesce(p_status,'在班')='在班'
 when p_role in ('同工','老師','工讀生') then coalesce(p_status,'在班') in ('在班','在職') else false end$function$
